name: Sasame Kaito
source:
A third-year student at Narahama High School, and an outstanding one at that: the top of his class.

Eloquent and handsome, the glimmer of his teeth simply blind every time he smiles. 
While he asserts that he is actually rather frail, he is the hard-working symbol of his school, from managing the dormitories to heading the student council. 

Those he speaks to are often astonished by his brilliant mind, as he is easily capable of reading what comes next in a conversation just from its flow.
